SALT deduction limit for 2025: $40,000. MAGI is under the $500,000 level where the limit starts to shrink, so they get the full amount.

All of its 2025 dividends ($6,706.86) were non-qualified, so they were taxed as ordinary income and also counted toward the NIIT. Both IRAs hold only equities, and together they hold about $610,292 of equities, which is enough room to hold the bond allocation. Decided to propose a swap: hold fixed income in the IRAs (SYN-23160002 and/or SYN-23160003) and equities in the joint account. Fernhollow Corporate Bond Fund shows an unrealized loss of $1,495.81 (basis $270,370.87), so selling it in the joint account creates no gain. However, buying Fernhollow Corporate Bond Fund back in an IRA within 30 days would turn that sale into a wash sale and the loss would be lost, so the IRA should buy a different bond fund. No trades until both clients approve.
